question: Who Owns Golden Corral?
quick_answer: Golden Corral is privately held. The brand, Golden Corral Corporation, is controlled by Investors Management Corporation (IMC), a Raleigh, North Carolina holding company tied to the family of co-founder James Maynard. Golden Corral was founded in 1973 in Fayetteville, North Carolina, by James Maynard and William F. Carl.
key_facts: Founders: James Maynard and William F. Carl
Controlled by: Investors Management Corporation (Maynard family)
Ownership: privately held, not publicly traded

body.heading: Who owns Golden Corral?
body.text: Golden Corral is a private, family-linked company. Its parent, Golden Corral Corporation, is controlled by Investors Management Corporation (IMC), a holding company based in Raleigh, North Carolina, connected to the family of co-founder James Maynard. It has never been a publicly traded company, and it is not owned by an outside private-equity firm.

body.heading: How Golden Corral started
body.text: Golden Corral opened its first restaurant in 1973 in Fayetteville, North Carolina, founded by James Maynard and William F. Carl. It grew into one of America's largest grill-buffet chains, famous for its all-you-can-eat buffet, carved meats, yeast rolls and the chocolate wonderfall fountain.

body.heading: Franchised, but family-controlled
body.text: Like many buffet chains, many Golden Corral locations are run by franchisees, but the brand itself stays under the founding family's control through IMC. That long-term private ownership is part of why Golden Corral has kept its buffet-first identity for decades.
